activity.notes: Harald V succeeded his father Olav V as King of Norway on 17 January 1991 and remained king until his death on 28 August 2026. The Norwegian Royal House records both boundaries explicitly. His earlier service as Crown Prince Regent during Olav V's illness in spring 1990 is historically attested but is not folded into this reign interval because the official biography does not fix an exact regency start day.
